title: Fix Copy and Paste Target Design Window Showing White
description: The TargetDesignWindow in CopyAndPaste.stories.tsx renders pasteTargetDesign (nakagin-capsule-tower.paste.design.compose.json) unflattened. Only the root piece has a plane; the 8 other pieces have no coordinates. ComposeDiagram renders raw planes so only the root appears and the rest is white. Fix: flatten the paste target design using the metabolism kit (which has all the type definitions), then render the flattened version in TargetDesignWindow.
